name: AM-ArcadeHall
label: Arcade Hall
about: a games room: the chosen game in a lit arcade cabinet (its marquee flickering on top, its video on the screen, its controls on the deck), the list a stack of glowing marquees, the default's gauges and sparks
idea: walking down a row of cabinets: every game is a lit marquee, the chosen one is the cabinet in front of you
keys: UP / DOWN: games   LEFT / RIGHT: playlists   SELECT: play   BACK: main menu
